name: Haus Hahnenkamm
beschreibung:
Peacefully set in Nesselwaengle, Haus Hahnenkamm welcomes visitors with cosy rooms and warm hospitality. It makes a wonderful base for outdoor lovers throughout the year.

The Krinnenalpbahn lift, Lake Haldensee, and trails up the valley's iconic climbing peaks are right nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Hahnenkamm in Nesselwaengle provides alpine tranquility and mountain views in the Tannheimer Tal.
